caption: This drawing depicts a teapot rendered in grayscale, with intricate decorative patterns covering its body, lid, spout, and handle. The teapot is oval-shaped with a domed lid that has a small knob at the top. The surface of the teapot is adorned with detailed floral motifs and several figures in relief, giving it a highly ornate appearance. The spout on the left and the angular handle on the right both feature additional decorative elements and appear textured. The base of the teapot is plain compared to the rest of the vessel. The drawing is signed “F. HASTINGS” in capital letters to the lower right of the teapot. The background is a blank, light-colored surface with some subtle discoloration at the edges.
title: Silver Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
